lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode: a car flipper hires a psychic to find a Lada Vesta. Lis is a deadpan ironic narrator. Last line is a confident, warm advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват», clear and not rushed.

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: greedy, excited, impatient. Line 2: outraged, sarcastic.

stas.profile: Stas — an exhausted Russian used-car flipper in his 30s who hasn't slept for three days.

mag.profile: Magister Eduard — a theatrical Russian TV-style psychic in his 50s, mysterious, dramatic pauses, low mystical voice.
mag.notes: Lines 1–3: mystical, dramatic, slow, with pauses on «…». Last line: smug, a bit mocking.

rustam.profile: Rustam — a cheerful Russian taxi-fleet guy selling an ex-taxi car, friendly, fast talker.

valera.profile: Valera — a sly Russian roadside car seller near Tambov.
valera.notes: One line: confident first, then guilty «Ну… чуть-чуть».
